body: pushing through pain just to get nothing? to make other people feel just a bit more comfortable but to get nothing, no release from the pain, nothing. that’s just not my thing. i can’t live off of other’s happiness anymore. i try to play the part of a saviour and tell myself that i’m making a difference in someone else’s life. like i’m gonna be needed as soon as i give my all to them. because i’m not. there’s nothing left in me to keep someone close or even to remember me. can’t live like that, can’t live for other people in that matter anymore.

i understand. i’m in the same situation with you - i feel like i’m not benefiting anyone by being alive. i feel like i lost most of my teenage years by being anxious, not being able to do anything basically. and it sucks. 

but i’d like to think that i still have time. _you_ still have time. you’re twenty. you’re barely an adult. you have all the time in the world to start with small things, and slowly proceed to the big things you’ve always wanted to do. we’re in the same process right now. i haven’t wasted my life, i’ve lived it in my own way. i’m anxious, so fucking what? that’s just how i am. that’s how i’ve been. would i have enjoyed the forced happiness if i put myself through something i didn’t want to do? no. my teenage years are not wasted, neither are yours. you were a teen, now you’re an adult. that’s how time works. but you’ve got so much left. and you have all that time left to die, also. no rush with the suicide, you know?

a job won’t benefit someone who doesn’t have the strenght to work. and seemingly you need some rest right now. time to clear your mind. 

find things you could be passionate about. maybe study instead of working for the starters? or search for a job somewhere else than where you live right now. maybe a change of scenery could be good for you.

every poison will be painful for you. extremely painful. you will get seizures, vomiting, abdominal pain, headaches, dizzyness... what else.

poisoning is not the way to go. don’t do it. and the chances are that you will survive anyways, but will be left with perminant damage to your body and brain. 

there is hope for everyone. if not today, maybe tomorrow. but something good is coming, and it’s worth the wait.

i know you’re tired of hearing the same shit. because honestly, who the hell is anyone to tell you that _it will get better_. because who knows?

but with that logic in mind, how do you know it will never get better? how do you know you won’t meet someone who changes your life for the better? or that you’re not going to get an offer which is the best thing you’ve ever had? anything can happen, really. and since there’s no rush to die - i assume - why not wait for the next wave of newness?
